source_note: 用真实石弥勒本体照片与母版生成近正面完整坐像，保留宽阔结跏双膝、禅定手、衣缘及圆形头光，不画现代卧佛或露天弥勒。只概括所见造像现状，不主张表面妆饰均为南朝原作；删除供桌、小像和廊柱等遮挡。输入输出已目视核查。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the HISTORIC GREAT STONE MAITREYA BUDDHA in the rock chamber at DAFO TEMPLE, XINCHANG, ZHEJIANG 新昌大佛寺石弥勒像, originally carved in the Southern Qi and Liang period (486–516). Use image2, the actual ancient seated image inside its rock-cut chamber, as the precise shape reference. It is NOT the modern reclining Buddha or outdoor smiling Budai. Image1 is only line style: DO NOT copy its Longmen face, broken arms or costume. Translate image2 into a restrained almost FRONTAL complete seated figure, correcting the camera's left-oblique upward angle while preserving the actual broad head, low curled hair with small rounded topknot, long ears, full cheeks, partly closed eyes, broad shoulders, thick neck, open U-shaped robe front, double robe edges and distinct shallow nested loops over the belly. Preserve BOTH HANDS held together horizontally in the LAP, palms upward in meditation, as actually photographed. Keep the very wide crossed knees and the cloth folding over the FRONT of the seat. Main head/body proportions must match this massive Xinchang figure, not a slender generic Buddha. Preserve its plain circular head halo joined to the simple broad rounded body backplate seen behind the shoulders; draw only fine outlines of those photographed shapes, no decorative flame halo, no new lotus pedestal, no extra attendant figures. Include the complete selected Buddha down to the modest rectangular seat base. Remove the modern flowers, offering table, small devotional statues, fans, lamps, wires, red architectural columns and railing that obstruct the subject. No enclosing temple hall. All gilding, red halo pigment, darkness and stone turn into PURE WHITE areas bounded by very fine BLACK contours. No dense curls, no black hair cap, no cavern shadow, no hatch shading. Depict the current surviving statue's outlines without claiming to reconstruct its original Southern Dynasties paint. A few sparse robe folds and hair arcs only, plenty of blank chest and robe planes, elegant thin organic contours as in image1. Portrait1024x1536, complete selected seated figure and halo centered at about80%height with ample all-around whitespace. No text.

historical_sources.title: 新昌县启动国保单位大佛寺石弥勒像30年来首次大修
historical_sources.publisher: 浙江省文化和旅游厅 / 新昌县文化广电旅游局
historical_sources.evidence: 明确石弥勒为江南齐梁造像，2021年启动约30年来首次大修，修缮对象包括裂缝及表层病害。

historical_sources.title: 《朱封鳌天台集》第一册·大佛寺怀台宗先祖，网页第210页
historical_sources.publisher: 浙江省地方志数字资源
historical_sources.evidence: 据《梁高僧传》等记载齐永明四年486年僧护居石城山，后续开凿；梁天监十二至十五年由僧祐完成。天监十五年即516。记述1990年代贴金维修，双膝宽10.6米。486表示相关发愿起源，具体动工另有齐建武说，不伪称整个期间连续施工。

site_recommendation.yearNote: 516为梁天监十五年成像；486为僧护相关发愿起源纪年，具体开凿另有齐建武年间说。区分寺院东晋创建和后代重修。
site_recommendation.latlon_note: 大佛寺公开对象坐标29°29′48.01″N120°53′44″E，供寺区地图落点，非像内测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 宽阔双膝托起沉静身躯，石弥勒在石城山岩室中结跏而坐。南朝齐梁间几代僧人接续开凿，留下江南早期大型佛教造像的珍贵实物。

facts.label: 齐梁成像
facts.text: 僧护发愿后，僧淑、僧祐接续营造，梁天监十五年（516）完成，旧称三世石佛。

facts.label: 依崖造像
facts.text: 弥勒像凿自石城山岩壁，结跏趺坐，两手置于膝间，双膝相距约10.6米。

facts.label: 历代修护
facts.text: 造像经历历代妆饰与修补，近现代多次保护修缮；图版取历史石像现状，不含景区现代卧佛。
